ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $5.00 no-show fee; no refund to the rider and no account action.
ruling.reasoning:
The driver cancelled and the records show he arrived and waited: "I'm Here" tapped at 18:17:45, 40 m from the pickup, inside the 200 m radius, with the closest approach 21 m [F7][F1]; he then stayed within 200 m for 5 min 40 s continuously [F2][F3][F6]; before cancelling he sent 3 in-app messages (first 18:18) and made 1 in-app call (18:19) [F5][F10][F14]. Every NS-1 condition (i)–(iv) is therefore met, so the $5.00 fee stands unless NS-3 applies [NS-1][F8].

The only question left open is why he cancelled [NS-0:reason]. No app reason was picked [F4], so his own words decide. His messages are purely about the pickup and the wait — "Reached, black Hyundai Ioniq, waiting at the pickup" [F10], "Hello? Still waiting ah, so slow" [F11], "Waited 5 min already, you never come, cancelling" [F12] — and his statement repeats the same: pressed "I'm Here", called, waited more than 5 minutes, rider did not come, so he cancelled [F15]. None of that is a reason of his own (car trouble, personal matter, another job, refusing the trip) — the cancellation was because the rider did not show, so NS-1 governs and NS-3 does not [NS-0][NS-1][F10][F11][F12][F15].

The rider's complaint that the driver "kept rushing me" is a description of pressure in the chat, not a threat, intimidation, harassment or dangerous-driving allegation; the messages themselves are abrupt but contain no threat or abuse [F11][F12]. The safety screen finds nothing: none [SAFE-1][F10][F11][F12][F15].

The fee is $5.00 [F8], fixed by NS-1; no route refund arises in a no-show case and the trace's NS-9 step fails (no prior no-show within 30 days, so no account flag on the rider) [F19][NS-9]. The rider's fraud flag only raises any threshold, it does not decide the case [F19]. The record is complete (GPS, timestamps, who cancelled) so the ruling is final under TH-1/TH-2: the fee stands.
